office_does: The Prosecuting Attorney prosecutes crimes in Okanogan County, represents the county in civil cases and advises county officers and school districts.
race_blurb: Uncontested: Prosecuting Attorney Albert Lin (Prefers Republican Party), appointed in 2022 and elected that November, is the only candidate.

candidates.summary: Okanogan County Prosecuting Attorney since his February 2022 appointment, previously a deputy prosecutor in Grant and Franklin counties; the only candidate.
highlights: Appointed by the county commissioners on Feb. 23, 2022 [S6]
Ten years as a Grant County and five as a Franklin County deputy prosecutor [S1]
